summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the Practice Map Selector 'hotel' fix. Logged in as admin@shooter.com, opened PRACTICE modal, verified GRAND HOTEL card is present (data-testid=practice-map-card-hotel), selected it, and confirmed START navigates to /play?mode=practice&map=hotel with a rendered canvas and no runtime error. Repeated for OFFLINE VS AI (mode=offline&map=hotel). Smoke check of a non-hotel map (random) also loaded successfully. No page errors, no blank screens.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'random' card in practice modal produces /play?mode=practice with no map param (expected behavior since server picks the map). Confirmed still works.
PracticeMapSelector card text ('N\nGRAND HOTEL') suggests a leading 'N' label glyph is rendered - visually unclear via text extraction; screenshot looks fine. Non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The hotel map selection bug is fixed. All three tested flows (practice+hotel, offline+hotel, practice+random) load the game canvas and show GO! start banner with the hotel arena rendering (buildings visible in-game). No console pageerrors during game load. LocalSim MAP_F entry is being picked correctly by _pickMap('hotel').
rca of the issue: Previous root cause (LocalSim MAPS array missing hotel) has been fixed by the main agent. Verified: selecting hotel card in either practice or offline vs AI mode now correctly navigates to /play?mode=<mode>&map=hotel and boots the arena without a blank screen or runtime error.
